notes.title: HELLCAM DEMO ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
The HELLCAM demo will be releasing shortly, on the 13th of November. The demo is not a complete and polished game, yet a short playthrough just to test optimization and receive feedback for the demo.

The demo will feature:

[list]
[*] Short backstory and lore.
[*] 15-30 minutes of level exploration.
[*] Hyper-realistic graphics.
[*] 2 endings.
[*] Realistic mechanics such as crouching, leaning, walking, zooming, etc.
[*] Controller support for Xbox and Dualshock Controllers.
[*] Dedicated discord server with support.
[/list]

[b]We ask that you join our discord to give us feedback directly ːsteamhappyː[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/8QJSC5pnBP]Join Our Discord Here[/url]

[previewyoutube=yR5CAGbipsk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]












[b]PC HELLCAM CONTROLS FOR DEMO[/b]

- Left Click / Right Click : [b]Zoom In and Out[/b]
- WASD : [b]Movement[/b]
- Mouse : [b]Look[/b]
- Q/E : [b]Lean[/b]
- F : [b]Interact[/b]
- C : [b]Crouch[/b]
